Commands:
  lang-server [--root <path>] [--output <dir>] [--csharp-server <path>]
      Start the CSX language server.
  build [--project <path>] [--configuration <Debug|Release>] [--framework <tfm>]
      Transform .cx files and build the project.
  run [--project <path>] [--configuration <Debug|Release>] [-- <app args>]
      Transform .cx files and run the project.
  enable <vscode|rider> [--version <version|latest>] [--repo <owner/name>]
      Download and install the matching IDE plugin from GitHub Releases.

Run 'csx build --help' or 'csx run --help' for more options.

result.stdout:
Usage: csx enable <vscode|rider> [--version <version|latest>] [--repo <owner/name>]

Downloads the matching IDE plugin from GitHub Releases and installs it.
By default the version of the running csx tool is used.

Environment overrides:
  CSX_VERSION             Version to install instead of the CLI version.
  CSX_REPOSITORY          GitHub repository (default: donkeh/csx).
  CSX_VSCODE_BIN          Path to the 'code' executable.
  CSX_RIDER_BIN           Path to the Rider executable.
  CSX_RIDER_PLUGINS_DIR   Rider plugins directory (skips auto-detection).
